idea-plugin.name: Commit Messages for Claude Code
idea-plugin.description:
Generates Conventional Commits messages from the changes you select in the commit panel, using your local Claude Code CLI.

Click the button next to Amend in the commit panel and the plugin will:

  • build a diff of the checked files only (including unversioned files and partial commits),
  • send it to claude -p together with the current branch name,
  • show the detected change type (feat, fix, refactor, docs…) and why,
  • fill in the commit message for you to review.

Requirements: macOS or Linux (Windows support is experimental), and the claude CLI installed and logged in. It uses your Claude subscription; no API key is needed. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

Settings (Settings → Tools → Commit Messages for Claude Code): model (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus), message language, timeout, matching the style of recent commits, always including a scope, and whether to overwrite an existing message without asking.

The plugin UI is available in English and Spanish and follows the IDE language.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.7.0

  • Experimental Windows support: finds claude.exe or npm's claude.cmd in PATH and the default install locations.
  • Clear error message when the Claude CLI cannot be started; Linux falls back to bash or sh when $SHELL is not set.

1.6.0

  • New setting "Always include a scope": titles always get a scope such as feat(settings): …, even if recent commits do not use one.

1.5.0

  • New default message language: "Same as IDE". Commit messages follow the IDE language unless you pick a fixed language in settings.

1.4.0

  • The plugin UI follows the IDE language: English, or Spanish when the IDE runs with a Spanish language pack.

1.3.0

  • The whole plugin is now in English: button, settings, notifications and dialogs.
  • Commit messages are written in English by default. Choose another language in settings; previously chosen languages are kept.

1.2.0

  • Matches your repository's style: the titles of the last 20 commits are sent as a reference (scopes, capitalization, ticket IDs). Can be turned off in settings.
  • Projects without Git installed no longer fail when reading the branch name.

1.1.5

  • With "overwrite without asking" enabled, the current message is cleared as soon as you click the button and restored if generation fails or is cancelled.

1.1.4

  • Renamed from "Claude Commit" to "Commit Messages for Claude Code".

1.1.3

  • Clear message when the Claude Code CLI is not logged in or the session has expired.

1.1.2

  • Fixed model selection with zsh.
  • Cancel and timeout now work with large diffs; UTF-8 everywhere.
  • Faster, more stable responses: no tools, no saved sessions, runs outside the project.
  • Warns when no file is checked instead of using the whole changelist.

1.1.0

  • Settings page: model, language, timeout, overwrite confirmation.
  • Unversioned files and partial commits are included; works with any VCS.
  • Saves open editors before building the diff; button disabled while running.
  • New plugin and button icons; compatible with 2025.2 – 2026.3.
